info.title: RetJet API
info.description:
Public API of [RetJet](https://retjet.com), the returns and warranty platform for online
shops. It handles returns from every sales channel a shop sells through, in one place.

Today it covers returns. Shipping and tracking will join it under the same base URL, each
versioned on its own, so nothing here changes when they do.

This API is what an integration talks to: a shop platform, a middleware, or a piece of
software you wrote yourself. With it you can register a return on a customer's behalf,
read the returns already registered, follow what happened to each of them, exchange
messages with the customer, and settle the amount to refund.

## Getting an API key

Generate a key in your RetJet account settings, under API keys. Keys belong to the
company rather than to the person who created them, so a key keeps working after that
person leaves. If you cannot find the section, ask us to enable API access for your
account.

## Authentication

All endpoints require a valid API key passed via the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>
```

## Rate limits

Two limits apply per key: 60 requests in quick succession, refilling at 60 per minute,
and 10 000 requests a day. Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`,
`X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` for whichever of the two is closest to
refusing you, and a refusal carries `Retry-After`, which says how long to wait.

## Identifying a request

Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header holding a unique identifier for that
call. It is worth keeping in your own logs: quoting it when you report a problem points
us straight at the record of what you sent, what we did about it and what came back,
rather than at a search by timestamp.

## Collections

Collection endpoints take `page` and `limit`. The default page size is 30 and the
largest accepted is 100.

Every collection response says how much there is, so you never have to fetch another
page to find out whether one exists:

| Header | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `X-Total-Count` | how many records match, across all pages |
| `X-Page` | the page you are looking at |
| `X-Per-Page` | how many records a page holds |
| `X-Total-Pages` | how many pages there are |

Where there is a page after or before this one, a `Link` header carries it ready to
follow, with your filters preserved:

```
Link: <https://api.retjet.com/returns/v1/rma-requests?limit=30&page=2>; rel="next"
```

A `Link` header with no `rel="next"` means you have reached the end. Endpoints that
always answer with a complete list, such as the dictionaries, report a single page
holding everything and send no `Link` at all.

## Response format

All responses are returned in JSON format. Successful responses return HTTP 200 for reads and HTTP 201 for resource creation.

## Error handling

| HTTP Code | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| 400 | Invalid request data — check the response body for field-level errors |
| 401 | Missing or invalid API key |
| 403 | Insufficient permissions for this operation |
| 404 | Requested resource not found |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded — retry after the indicated delay |
| 500 | Internal server error — contact support if persistent |
